services.name: New Castle County EMS (County Paramedics)
services.area: whole county, ALS non-transport (rides in BLS ambulance)
services.evidence: The paramedic units operate in a tiered response configuration with the basic life support (BLS) ambulances of the volunteer fire service and contractual ambulance service for the City of Wilmington.

services.name: New Castle County volunteer fire company BLS ambulances (set; county page counts 21)
services.area: county outside the City of Wilmington
services.evidence: ...tiered response configuration with the basic life support (BLS) ambulances of the volunteer fire service...

services.name: Saint Francis EMS (Trinity Health Mid-Atlantic)
services.evidence: Saint Francis EMS is the largest Basic Life Support (BLS) provider in the state of Delaware, delivering 911 EMS care in the City of Wilmington and the City of Dover

10003.page_note: Two-tier system: county paramedics (ALS, non-transport) ride with BLS ambulances run by the volunteer fire companies; Wilmington BLS is contracted (Saint Francis EMS). Individual fire companies not listed one by one.

services.name: Sussex County EMS (SCEMS)
services.evidence: SCEMS is a non-transporting EMS agency, using specially designed rapid response vehicles.

services.name: Sussex County fire company / BLS transport services (set; county page counts 21)
services.evidence: Transportation of patients is provided by 21 BLS transport services (with a SCEMS Paramedic on-board if the patient meets ALS criteria), or by ALS helicopter service provided by the Delaware State Police or Christiana LifeNet

10005.page_note: County paramedics do not transport; 21 BLS services (mostly volunteer fire companies) carry patients. Individual services not named by the source.
